about.metaDescription: Etleq is a SaaS launch studio that builds Arabic-first software products and takes them live in 30 days at a fixed price. Meet the founders.
about.title: We build your product like it's our own
about.lead: Etleq is a SaaS launch studio founded by engineers and run by a team of engineers and specialists. We build Arabic-first SaaS products on a ready foundation called Etleq Core and take them live in 30 days at a fixed price.
story: We kept meeting Gulf business owners with a clear idea and customers waiting, who then got stuck on the build: agencies that need months and big budgets, freelancers who disappear after launch, and AI builders that stall at payments, Arabic and invoicing.

So we built one technical foundation with what every product needs before day one: an Arabic interface, mada and Apple Pay billing, ZATCA-ready invoicing, hosting and backups. That way the build time goes into what makes your idea different.
about.mission: Every business owner in the Gulf should be able to own a working product that takes payments, without hiring a tech team.
about.foundersLead: A background in software engineering and data science.

values.title: Fixed price
values.text: You know the cost before we start. No open-ended hourly bills.

values.title: Guaranteed launch date
values.text: If we're late, we refund 10% of the build fee for every late week and keep building.

values.title: Honest promises
values.text: We don't promise you profit. We promise a working product, a launch date and support after launch.

values.title: Arabic first
values.text: We design and write in Arabic from the start, not as a translation at the end.
